profile.ja: 未来世界のレジスタンス組織“Bandit”の構成員。元々はブレインフレーヤーの傘下組織に囚われていた実験体であり、改造手術によりESP能力を植え付けられている。研究施設から救い出してくれた篠原まり達に恩を感じて、Banditの構成員として活動するようになった。Banditでは、テレパシー能力を活かした情報伝達や、敵の思考を読み取る諜報活動を主な任務として受け持っている。直接戦闘はあまり得意ではないが、テレパシーの出力を最大限まで高めれば多少の精神操作も可能らしい。趣味は甘いものを食べることと、惰眠を貪ること。ESPの行使は脳神経を酷使するらしく、栄養を補給するという名目で貴重なお菓子をお腹いっぱい食べたり、休息しないと肝心な時に働けないからと言って居眠りしがち。噂に聞く五車町の稲毛屋にはいつか巡礼して、たらふく甘味を食べてみたいと夢見ている。口答えが多く、ゆるい見た目やものぐさな言動から不真面目な印象を与えてしまうこともあるが、引き受けた任務はしっかりと行う。
profile.en: She is a member of the resistance organization "Bandit" in the future world. Originally, she was an experimental body held by an organization under Brain Flayer, and she was implanted with ESP abilities through modification surgery. After being rescued from the research facility by Shinohara Mari and others, she felt a sense of gratitude and began to work as a member of Bandit. In Bandit, she is mainly in charge of tasks such as information transmission using her telepathic abilities and espionage activities that read the thoughts of enemies. Although she is not very good at direct combat, she can perform some mental manipulation if she maximizes her telepathic output. Her hobbies are eating sweet things and indulging in laziness. The use of ESP seems to overwork her brain nerves, so she eats a lot of precious sweets as a way to replenish her nutrition and often takes naps, saying that she won't be able to work when it matters if she doesn't rest. She dreams of making a pilgrimage to the Inomata store in Gosha town, which she has heard about through rumors, and wants to eat a lot of sweets there.
